subject: Luminary: hosted API usage shape, monthly token ask & peak concurrency
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Charlie Park <charlie@luminary.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@luminary.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 17:23:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up: hosted API monthly tokens + peak profile (post-demo)

Thanks for taking the demo earlier — good conversation. I promised a short recap + a couple of specific asks so our pricing and perf teams can model a clean proposal. See the attached usage snapshot (luminary_usage_snapshot.csv) which you referenced on the call.

Topline asks to confirm:
- Rough expected monthly token volume (tokens/month) for year-1 launch and steady-state.
- Typical request shape: avg input tokens, avg generation tokens, total tokens/request.
- Expected peak concurrency window and how long bursts last (minutes). We need peak TPS expressed as tokens/sec (or requests/sec + avg tokens/request).
- Target budget range or $/1M-token target you have in mind (helps us decide reserved vs usage pricing).
- Any compliance or region constraints (we have US/EU options).

If you can reply with ranges (best guess is fine) we'll sketch 2 pricing options (committed slab vs usage) and a simple cost estimate for your expected ramp.

Next steps we propose:
1) You share an estimate for the bullets above (2–3 numbers is fine).
2) We send a short pricing sketch and an optional 30-day POC plan to validate peak.
3) If numbers look good, we put together an LOI/term sheet.

Thanks — attaching the usage snapshot you mentioned.

—
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
redwood.com

Attachment: luminary_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV export — anonymized sample of their last 14 days)

From: Charlie Park <charlie@luminary.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@luminary.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 19:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: hosted API monthly tokens + peak profile (post-demo)

Aisha — thanks, appreciate the clear asks. Below are our current internal estimates (rough, happy to refine). I included a very small prod spike log as discussed (luminary_prod_spike_log.csv).

Year-1 launch (conservative): 450,000,000 tokens / month
Steady-state (target): 1.2B tokens / month (12–18 month horizon)

Request shape (approx averages):
- Avg input tokens: ~120
- Avg generated tokens: ~230
- Total tokens per request: ~350

Traffic shape and peak:
- Typical baseline: ~40 requests/sec globally (varies by hour)
- Expected peak (on marketing/feature launch days): short bursts up to ~50 req/sec for ~10–20 minutes; longer sustained high days can hit ~80 req/sec for a few hours.
- Using avg 350 tokens/request -> peak tokens/sec estimate: 50 * 350 = 17,500 tokens/sec (short burst); 80 * 350 = 28,000 tokens/sec (sustained peak day).

Budget and target $/1M tokens
- Internal procurement target: budget band $6k–$9k/mo initially for the pilot (year-1 ramp limited).
- Strategic target for evaluation: $10–$12 per 1M tokens (we want a committed price if we hit 400M+).

Notes:
- We can provide a 30-day traffic export if your SREs want to run a cost/latency model.
- No EU-only requirement for the pilot; production may require EU region options later.

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the CSV if useful.

—
Charlie Park
Head of Platform, Luminary AI
charlie@luminary.ai | +1 212-555-0199

Attachment: luminary_prod_spike_log.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Charlie Park <charlie@luminary.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Nov 2025 21:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick follow-up: hosted API monthly tokens + peak profile (post-demo)

Quick internal note — forwarding Charlie's numbers. Two pricing sketches I recommend we prepare:

Option A — Committed slab (6–12 month term):
- Commitment: 500M tokens/mo slab (first 6 months ramped usage allowance).
- Price: $9 per 1M tokens on committed volume; $12 per 1M overage.
- Benefits: predictable unit cost for Luminary at scale, reserved capacity for peak handling, 99.9% uptime target with canary fallback.

Option B — Usage-first (no commit):
- Price: $15 per 1M tokens on consumed volume.
- Includes burst credits for short spikes (automated throttling options) and a 30-day POC to validate peak e2e.

Ask: before we send to Betty in Legal/Procurement, we should confirm: (1) their preferred term length for a commitment, (2) a procurement contact for PO/contract, and (3) whether they need EU-only hosting for year-1.

I'll draft a 1-page pricing sketch + an ops checklist to validate the peak numbers. Ben — can you add a quick note on quantization/latency expectations for their 28k tokens/sec sustained scenario?

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Charlie Park <charlie@luminary.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@luminary.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: hosted API monthly tokens + peak profile (post-demo)

Thanks Charlie — this is exactly what we needed to run a realistic sketch. Short summary and next steps so nothing falls through the cracks:

Summary of your inputs (we'll use these in the model):
- Pilot monthly volume: 450M tokens/month
- Steady-state target: 1.2B tokens/month
- Avg tokens/request: ~350
- Peak short burst (tokens/sec): ~17,500; sustained peak day up to ~28,000 tokens/sec
- Budget/target $/1M tokens: $10–$12 (procurement target $6k–$9k/month for pilot)

Our immediate next actions:
1) Redwood -> send 1-page pricing sketch + a 30-day POC plan (we'll include Option A/B noted by Karthik) — target EOD Thu PST. Attachment: redwood_pricing_sketch.pdf will be included.
2) Luminary -> confirm procurement contact and preferred term (email for PO/contract) and whether EU-only hosting is required.
3) Ops -> if you want model validation, upload a 48-hour export and we'll run a quick synthetic peak test against our hosted staging.

Can you confirm procurement contact and whether the $10–$12 target is a hard requirement or a starting point for negotiation? Once we have that, we'll prepare the LOI language and a technical checklist for the POC.

Thanks again — will push the sketch and ops checklist shortly.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_pricing_sketch.pdf (pricing sketch + options)
body_preview: Post-demo ask: confirm monthly tokens, avg tokens/request, and peak tokens/sec. Charlie estimates 450M/month and bursts up to 28k tokens/sec. Redwood to send pricing sketch and POC plan.
